exactFailureMechanism: resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness (lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/tools.ts) takes its currentText!==null branch unconditionally without re-checking view.status. This branch's own header comment asserts non-null currentText only occurs when status===OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED - this is false: buildProvisionView leaves currentText as the untouched base text (non-null) whenever a real, on-file amendment exists but its own effective-date condition is genuinely unresolved (AMENDMENT_SEQUENCE_UNRESOLVED, producing an aggregate OPERATIVE_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED), since that amendment never enters appliedChain and so never triggers the null-out. The fix must additionally gate the currentText!==null branch on view.status itself, not merely on currentText's presence - the exact same class of bug this phase set out to fix, one layer deeper.
